name: Radiant Heat Under Hardwood in Redmond: Refinishing Considerations
title-tag: Refinishing Hardwood Over Radiant Heat in Redmond, WA
meta-description: Hardwood over radiant heat can be refinished at the usual $3.99/sq ft. The heat schedule, the tubing rule, seasonal timing, and the wear-layer check first.
post-summary: April 5, 2027 · Hardwood over radiant heat sands and refinishes like any other floor — the difference is the schedule. The heat ramp down and back up, finding the tubing before any fastener goes in, why winter is the wrong time to fill gaps, and the wear-layer check that decides everything.
